text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking around the academy after
school
when I see someone dancing to
music.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: One! Two! Three! Then here I...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Tuuuurn!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Oh! Sorry! I almost bumped into you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No need to apologize! I should've been
paying
attention to my surroundings.
choice_data_list: 大丈夫、こちらこそごめん

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I was too focused on my finger
movements and
grew careless...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah! It's a little embarrassing to
admit, but I'm
not great at splitting my
attention between
things...
choice_data_list: 細かい動きは集中力を使うもんな
細かい動きは集中力を使うもんね

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hm... What should I do in order to dance
more
delicately, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You're right. There are no shortcuts to
learning. I
won't improve if I don't put in
the effort!
choice_data_list: あえて曲のテンポを上げてみては？

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Time to dial up my practices a
notch.
Thanks for the advice!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time later, I'm on my way home
after
finishing my work when I see
someone familiar.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey! It's you again! Are you headed
home for
the day?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm planning to practice until right
before curfew!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I feel like my hard work's paid off and
I've already
improved a bit!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I may have gotten a little better,
but I've
still got a long ways to go! To
greater heights!
choice_data_list: 本当だ、上手になってる……！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a pleasant smile, Narita Top Road
returns to
her practice.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Speed up the song? What for?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Once I get used to the higher
speed, playing
it at normal speed will
make it feel slower and
therefore easier
to follow, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You're a genius! I'm going to try it right
now!
Could you clap to set the tempo
for me, please?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: One! Two! Three!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Eh? Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ouch... Yeah, I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that wasn't the best idea after
all. I'm
about to suggest she take it easy,
but she starts
laughing before I can say
anything.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! Now I really want to get it right!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure the process of learning to do
this
properly will help me improve.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It was pretty reckless of me to jump right
in,
though! I think I'll focus on learning
the steps first!
